messages.content: Write a Python worker that pulls items off a queue.Queue in a thread and processes each with a callback. Around 50 lines.

Created `callback_worker.py` (49 lines). `CallbackWorker` runs a background thread that blocks on `queue.get()`, invokes `callback(item)` for each item, catches exceptions so one bad item doesn't kill the loop, and shuts down cleanly via a sentinel when `stop()` is called.
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.
